intent: Implement AuditEntry (Java 21, Spring Boot 3, WebFlux/Reactor/R2DBC, constructor injection, no blocking calls) so that the frozen test passes, providing exactly the ast_hints table and nothing improvised. Unit contract: Shared audit trail record: actor, action, outcome (SUCCESS|FAILURE), timestamp, correlationId (the requestId). Immutable record; the outcome literals SUCCESS and FAILURE are owned here and consumers pin this unit.

methods.signature: AuditEntry(String actor, AuditAction action, String outcome, Instant timestamp, String correlationId)
methods.semantics: Null rejected (NullPointerException); actor and correlationId non-blank; outcome is exactly SUCCESS or FAILURE (IllegalArgumentException otherwise).
